approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content, with file-grounded project questions modeled on Trunk Tools.
notes: Reproduce an RFI Question answer cited only to the same identifier's Response, and the inverse swap.
Ground explicit Question and Response roles against the same exact RFI identity in the shared final answer validator.
Keep two explicit RFI role claims in one answer statement paired to their nearest exact identities instead of skipping validation.
Accept Answer, Reply and Official Response as Response wording equivalents and an exact one-identity locator as support.
Do not infer a response role from Response Date, Response Time or a multi-identity locator.
Use synthetic evidence and make no provider request.
title: Ground RFI question and response roles
objective: Prevent an explicit RFI Question or Response claim from borrowing the opposite role under the same identifier or from another locator scope.
